messages:
nate (product): Idea: credit-smoothing for reserved pools - instead of a hard daily cap, provide a per-minute soft band that evens bursts over the hour. Goal: reduce sudden depletion and noisy neighbor effects. Thoughts?

sam (eng-runtime): Sounds promising. Implementation: sliding-window token bucket with min-guarantee + soft headroom. Need atomic ledger and quick checks in scheduler. Potential complexity: more frequent accounting events.

priya (eng-sre): Safety: must bound how long smoothing can mask overcommit. propose: smoothing_window <= 60min and max_deficit = 25% of daily band. Also require alerts when deficit > 10% for 30m.

anya (data): From historical traces, smoothing could lower peak drain events by ~35% for chat-style tenants. I'll run sims to recommend defaults for small/med/large pools.

meredith (sales): Customers want predictability. We should expose an "explain" panel showing how smoothing affects their burst SLA. Also two SKUs: smoothing-basic (no rollover) and smoothing-plus (allows limited deficit rollover).

sam (eng-runtime): config sketch:
```
credit_smoothing:
  window_minutes: 60
  max_deficit_pct: 25
  min_guarantee_pct: 70
  settle_time: 03:00 UTC
```
Smoothing will annotate requests with header x-rw-served-mode: "smoothed" | "baseline" | "preempted".

priya (eng-sre): Launch criteria:
- telemetry: smoothed_credits_used, deficit_pct, minutes_in_deficit, p95/p99 by mode
- pilot: 4 tenants for 21 days across workload shapes
- SLO gate: smoothed p95 <= baseline p95 + 15ms; p99 regression capped at 8%
- rollback: auto-disable smoothing in region if deficit_pct > 20% for 4h or p99 regressions > 0.5%
- ops runbook: page owners, steps to revoke smoothing per-tenant, how to quarantine noisy tenants

anya (data): I'll provide a three-tier default suggestion and an expected reduction in peak drain by end of week. Also will simulate cost impact for smoothing-plus.

meredith (sales): I'll prepare pilot offer language and the customer FAQ. Need example billing language for smoothing-plus (monthly fee + capped overage).

ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/credit-smoothing (access: product, eng-runtime, eng-sre, data, sales).

nate (product): Owners & timeline: sam prototype in 3w, anya sims in 7d, priya SLOs/runbook in 2w, meredith pilot comms in 1w. Target pilot kickoff in 5w, GA in 12w if gates pass. I'll post checklist Monday. :white_check_mark:

sam (eng-runtime): ack, creating ticket.
